shared_elements: T-shaped monolithic pillar with broad flat shaft as the decorated surface
quadruped animal carved in relief on the pillar shaft
animal oriented along the vertical axis of the shaft, head downward/forward
more than one carving stacked vertically on the same face
plain undecorated broad head/capital above the carved shaft
justification: Both surfaces are T-shaped pillars whose narrow vertical shaft carries a quadruped animal aligned head-downward along the axis, with a further carving below it and an entirely plain capital above — a highly specific and arbitrary decorative scheme rather than a generic "animal image". The chief difference in depicted content is the manner of the animal: A shows a flat, low-relief profile quadruped with all four legs on the plane (plus a second, fainter creature lower down), whereas B's animal is a fully three-dimensional, almost sculptural body projecting from the shaft, making the shared scheme more similar than the shared rendering conventions.
